However, pressing an entry won't do anything. **It is hence time to tackle the implementation of the tap-to-scroll feature! Let's jump to Part III.**

## Part III — Create A WebView-free Blog App with React Native Render HTML

This article is the part III of the *Create a WebView-free Blog App with React Native Render HTML* serie. See also Part I and Part II.

> Tip: The source code of this case study is available in the `main` branch of this repo: [`jsamr/rnrh-blog`](https://github.com/jsamr/rnrh-blog). The `enhanced` branch contains a few more features beyond this tutorial, such as a refined UI, dark mode, caching with [react-queries](https://react-query.tanstack.com/)... etc. You can try out the **enhanced** version right now with expo, see [the project page](https://expo.io/@jsamr/react-native-blog) for instructions.

> Tip: If you have any question or remarks regarding this tutorial, [you're welcome in our Discord channel](https://discord.gg/dbEMMJM).

### Tap To Scroll Feature

#### The `Scroller` Class

We'll put all the scrolling logic in a `Scroller` class that we'll later use with hooks. Create this new file: `utils/Scroller.ts`:

```ts title="utils/Scroller.ts"
import { MutableRefObject } from "react";
import { LayoutChangeEvent, Platform, ScrollViewProps } from "react-native";
import { ScrollView } from "react-native-gesture-handler";
import { EventEmitter } from "events";

// This is the min distance from the top edge of the scroll view
// to select a heading
const MIN_DIST_FROM_TOP_EDG = 15;

export default class Scroller {
  private ref: MutableRefObject<ScrollView | null>;
  private entriesMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  private entriesCoordinates: Array<[string, number]> = [];
  private eventEmitter = new EventEmitter();
  private lastEntryName = "";
  private offset = 0;

  constructor(ref: MutableRefObject<ScrollView | null>) {
    this.ref = ref;
  }

  handlers: ScrollViewProps = {
    onContentSizeChange: () => {
      this.entriesCoordinates = Object.entries(this.entriesMap).sort(
        (a, b) => a[1] - b[1]
      );
    },
    onScroll: ({ nativeEvent }) => {
      const offsetY =
        nativeEvent.contentOffset.y - this.offset + MIN_DIST_FROM_TOP_EDG;
      const layoutHeight = nativeEvent.layoutMeasurement.height;
      // We use a conditional to avoid overheading the JS thread on Android.
      // On iOS, scrollEventThrottle will do the work.
      if (Platform.OS !== "android" || Math.abs(nativeEvent.velocity!.y) < 1) {
        for (let i = 0; i < this.entriesCoordinates.length; i++) {
          const [entryName, lowerBound] = this.entriesCoordinates[i];
          const upperBound =
            i < this.entriesCoordinates.length - 1
              ? this.entriesCoordinates[i + 1][1]
              : lowerBound + layoutHeight;
          if (offsetY >= lowerBound && offsetY < upperBound) {
            if (entryName !== this.lastEntryName) {
              this.eventEmitter.emit("select-entry", entryName);
              this.lastEntryName = entryName;
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    },
  };

  setOffset(offset: number) {
    this.offset = offset;
  }

  addSelectedEntryListener(listener: (entryName: string) => void) {
    this.eventEmitter.addListener("select-entry", listener);
  }

  removeSelectedEntryListener(listener: (entryName: string) => void) {
    this.eventEmitter.removeListener("select-entry", listener);
  }

  registerScrollEntry(name: string, layout: LayoutChangeEvent) {
    this.entriesMap[name] = layout.nativeEvent.layout.y;
  }

  scrollToEntry(entryName: string) {
    if (entryName in this.entriesMap) {
      this.ref.current?.scrollTo({
        y: this.entriesMap[entryName] + this.offset - MIN_DIST_FROM_TOP_EDG,
        animated: true,
      });
    }
  }
}
```

Below is a summary of each member in this class.

- `constructor` — The constructor takes a `ScrollView` ref to enable the `scrollToEntry` method.
- `addSelectedEntryListener` — A method to listen to selected entry changes. This will be useful in the table of content drawer to update the active entry on scroll.
- `removeSelectedEntryListener` — A method to free a listener to selected entry changes.
- `registerScrollEntry` — A method to be used with `onLayout` in order to store the coordinates of each entry in the body of the article.
- `handlers` — Event handlers to be passed to a `ScrollView` component. The `onScroll` handler will be used to update the selected entry in the table of content drawer.
- `setOffset` — A method to set the offset of the `headings` container. Because of the DOM structure offered by Docusaurus which looks like:

  ```html
  <article>
    <header>...</header>
    <div class="markdown">
      <h2>...</h2>
      <h3>...</h3>
    </div>
  </article>
  ```

  the computed headings tags coordinates will be relative to the `<div>` rather than relative to the `ScrollView` content, and we need to adjust to that.
- `scrollToEntry` — A method to imperatively scroll to the given entry name.

#### Sharing the `Scroller` in a React Context

Let's start by creating a scroller context and export the relevant hook and provider:

```ts title="utils/scroller.tsx"
import React, { createContext, PropsWithChildren, useContext } from "react";
import Scroller from './Scroller';

const scrollerContext = createContext<Scroller>(null as any);

export function useScroller(): Scroller {
  return useContext(scrollerContext);
}

export function ScrollerProvider({
  children,
  scroller
}: PropsWithChildren<{ scroller: Scroller }>) {
  return (
    <scrollerContext.Provider value={scroller}>
      {children}
    </scrollerContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

Then we can provide a `scroller` instance from the `ArticleScreen` component, and scroll to the targeted entry on menu entry press.

```tsx {1,3-4,8-15,22-26,34,41,49} title="screens/ArticleScreen.tsx"
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
// ... other imports
import Scroller from "../utils/Scroller";
import { ScrollerProvider } from "../utils/scroller";

// other hooks

function useScrollFeature(scrollerDep: any) {
  const scrollViewRef = useRef<null | ScrollView>(null);
  const scroller = useMemo(() => new Scroller(scrollViewRef), [scrollerDep]);
  return {
    scroller,
    scrollViewRef,
  };
}

export default function ArticleScreen(props: ArticleScreenProps) {
  useSetTitleEffect(props);
  const url = props.route.params.url;
  const { dom, headings } = useArticleDom(url);
  const { drawerRef, openDrawer, closeDrawer } = useDrawer();
  const { scrollViewRef, scroller } = useScrollFeature(url);
  const onPressEntry = useCallback((entry: string) => {
    closeDrawer();
    scroller.scrollToEntry(entry);
  }, [scroller]);
  const renderToc = useCallback(
    function renderToc() {
      return <TOC headings={headings} onPressEntry={onPressEntry} />;
    },
    [headings]
  );
  return (
    <ScrollerProvider scroller={scroller}>
      <DrawerLayout
        drawerPosition="right"
        drawerWidth={300}
        renderNavigationView={renderToc}
        ref={drawerRef}
      >
        <ArticleBody scrollViewRef={scrollViewRef} dom={dom} />
        <FAB
          style={styles.fab}
          color="#61dafb"
          icon="format-list-bulleted-square"
          onPress={openDrawer}
        />
      </DrawerLayout>
    </ScrollerProvider>
  );
}

// styles
```

Finally, we must consume the `scrollViewRef` in the `ArticleBody` component, and pass the `Scroller.handlers` event handlers to the `ScrollView` component:

```tsx {3,9,12,16,19} title="components/ArticleBody.tsx"
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
// ... other imports
import { useScroller } from "../utils/scroller";

// other definitions

export default function ArticleBody({
  dom,
  scrollViewRef
}: {
  dom: Document | null;
  scrollViewRef: any;
}) {
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const availableWidth = Math.min(width, 500);
  const scroller = useScroller();
  return (
    <ScrollView
      {...scroller.handlers}
      style={styles.container}
      ref={scrollViewRef}
      scrollEventThrottle={100}
      // other props
    >
      {/* ... */}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}
```

Great! Nevertheless we have yet two unaddressed issues:

- Update selected entry on scroll in the `TOC`;
- Register headings layouts. We will use a custom renderer for that purpose.

#### Listening to Entry Changes in `TOC`

First of all, I propose to factor the logic of adding a listener to selected entry changes in a separate hook (`hooks/useOnEntryChangeEffect.ts`):

```ts title="hooks/useOnEntryChangeEffect.ts"
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useScroller } from "../utils/scroller";

export default function useOnEntryChangeEffect(
  onEntryChange: (entryName: string) => void
) {
  const scroller = useScroller();
  useEffect(
    function updateActiveTargetOnScroll() {
      scroller.addSelectedEntryListener(onEntryChange);
      return () => scroller.removeSelectedEntryListener(onEntryChange);
    },
    [scroller, onEntryChange]
  );
}
```

Then, we just need to consume this hook from the `TOC` component:

```ts {2,14} title="components/TOC.tsx"
// ...other imports
import useOnEntryChangeEffect from "../hooks/useOnEntryChangeEffect";

export default function TOC({
  headings,
  onPressEntry,
}: {
  headings: Element[];
  onPressEntry?: (name: string) => void;
}) {
  const [activeEntry, setActiveEntry] = useState(
    headings.length ? textContent(headings[0]) : ""
  );
  useOnEntryChangeEffect(setActiveEntry);
  // ...
}
```

#### Register Headings Layouts

The `Scroller` is still missing the coordinates of each heading to be able to properly `scrollToEntry`. For this purpose, we are going to create a custom renderer (see the Custom Renderers guide) for `<h2>` and `<h3>` tags. We will also need to register a `<header>` renderer to store the header height. If you remember well, the DOM has a structure like below:

```html
<article>
  <!-- We need to account for the header height -->
  <header>...</header>
  <div class="markdown">
    <h2>...</h2>
    <h3>...</h3>
  </div>
</article>
```

Let's get back to `components/WebEngine.tsx` and register both renderers here:

```tsx title="components/WebEngine.tsx"
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import {
  CustomBlockRenderer,
  CustomTagRendererRecord,
  RenderHTMLConfigProvider,
  TRenderEngineProvider,
  TRenderEngineConfig,
} from "react-native-render-html";
import { findOne, textContent } from "domutils";
import { useScroller } from "../utils/scroller";
import { LayoutChangeEvent } from "react-native";

const HeadingRenderer: CustomBlockRenderer = function HeaderRenderer({
  TDefaultRenderer,
  ...props
}) {
  const scroller = useScroller();
  const onLayout = useCallback(
    (e: LayoutChangeEvent) => {
      scroller.registerScrollEntry(textContent(props.tnode.domNode!), e);
    },
    [scroller]
  );
  return <TDefaultRenderer {...props} viewProps={{ onLayout }} />;
};

const HeaderRenderer: CustomBlockRenderer = function HeaderRenderer({
  TDefaultRenderer,
  ...props
}) {
  const scroller = useScroller();
  const onLayout = useCallback(
    (e: LayoutChangeEvent) => {
      scroller.setOffset(e.nativeEvent.layout.y + e.nativeEvent.layout.height);
    },
    [scroller]
  );
  return <TDefaultRenderer {...props} viewProps={{ onLayout }} />;
};

const renderers: CustomTagRendererRecord = {
  h2: HeadingRenderer,
  h3: HeadingRenderer,
  header: HeaderRenderer,
};

const selectDomRoot: TRenderEngineConfig["selectDomRoot"] = (node) =>
  findOne((e) => e.name === "article", node.children, true);

const ignoredDomTags = ["button", "footer"];

export default function WebEngine({ children }: React.PropsWithChildren<{}>) {
  // Every prop is defined outside of the function component.
  // This is important to prevent extraneous rebuilts of the engine.
  return (
    <TRenderEngineProvider
      ignoredDomTags={ignoredDomTags}
      selectDomRoot={selectDomRoot}
    >
      <RenderHTMLConfigProvider
        renderers={renderers}
        enableExperimentalMarginCollapsing
      >
        {children}
      </RenderHTMLConfigProvider>
    </TRenderEngineProvider>
  );
}
```

Because the `<h2>`, `<h3>` and `<header>` tags have a content model set to **block**, they will be rendered in a `View`, so we can pass `onLayout` in `TDefaultRendererProps.viewProps` prop.

Hence we're done with the tap-to-scroll feature! But the `ArticleBody` is still pretty ugly, so we'll use some styles and fixes to prettify it!

### Styling Refinements

#### Fixing the Avatar

The avatar should be 50x50 and its container displayed in row. We are going to fix it in two steps:

1. By targeting the container class with styles to display in row;
2. By setting a custom `<img>` renderer to fix the size.

So let's edit the `components/WebEngine` to apply those fixes:

```tsx {5,9,15-21,26,31-63,70} title="components/WebEngine"
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import {
  CustomBlockRenderer,
  CustomTagRendererRecord,
  MixedStyleRecord,
  RenderHTMLConfigProvider,
  TRenderEngineProvider,
  TRenderEngineConfig,
  useInternalRenderer,
} from "react-native-render-html";
// ... other imports

// HeaderRenderer

const ImageRenderer: CustomBlockRenderer = function ImageRenderer(props) {
  const { Renderer, rendererProps } = useInternalRenderer("img", props);
  if (props.tnode.parent?.hasClass("avatar__photo")) {
    return <Renderer {...rendererProps} width={50} height={50} />;
  }
  return <Renderer {...rendererProps} />;
};

const renderers: CustomTagRendererRecord = {
  h2: HeadingRenderer,
  h3: HeadingRenderer,
  img: ImageRenderer
};

// ... other definitions

const classesStyles: MixedStyleRecord = {
  avatar: {
    marginTop: 10,
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    flexWrap: "nowrap",
  },
  avatar__photo: {
    width: 50,
    height: 50,
    borderRadius: 25,
    overflow: "hidden",
  },
  avatar__intro: {
    flexShrink: 1,
    alignItems: "flex-start",
  },
  avatar__name: {
    fontWeight: "bold",
    flexGrow: 0,
    marginBottom: 10,
  },
  avatar__subtitle: {
    color: "rgb(118, 118, 118)",
    fontWeight: "bold",
    lineHeight: 16,
  },
  "avatar__photo-link": {
    borderRadius: 25,
    marginRight: 10,
    overflow: "hidden",
  },
}

export default function WebEngine({ children }: React.PropsWithChildren<{}>) {
  return (
    <TRenderEngineProvider
      ignoredDomTags={ignoredDomTags}
      selectDomRoot={selectDomRoot}
      classesStyles={classesStyles}
      // other props
    >
    {/*...*/}
    </TRenderEngineProvider>
  );
}
```

#### Fixing Paragraphs in `<li>` Elements

Paragraphs nested in `<li>` elements have top and bottom margins, which is undesirable. To fix the issue, we're going to add a custom `<p>` renderer like so:

```tsx title="components/WebEngine.tsx"
// renderers and imports

const ParagraphRenderer: CustomBlockRenderer = function ParagraphRenderer({
  TDefaultRenderer,
  tnode,
  ...props
}) {
  const marginsFix =
    tnode.markers.olNestLevel > -1 || tnode.markers.ulNestLevel > -1
      ? { marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 0 }
      : null;
  return (
    <TDefaultRenderer
      {...props}
      tnode={tnode}
      style={[props.style, marginsFix]}
    />
  );
};

const renderers: CustomTagRendererRecord = {
  // ... other renderers
  p: ParagraphRenderer
};
```

> Note: We are using `markers` which contain the current nest level of `ol` and `ul` elements to assess if we are rendering inside a list. See `Markers`.

#### Discard `#` anchors appended to Headings by Docusaurus

These elements have a `"hash-link"` class, so we can use `ignoreDomNode` to discard them:

```tsx {5,15-16,25} title="components/WebEngine.tsx"
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import {
  CustomBlockRenderer,
  CustomTagRendererRecord,
  isDomElement,
  MixedStyleRecord,
  RenderHTMLConfigProvider,
  TRenderEngineProvider,
  TRenderEngineConfig,
  useInternalRenderer,
} from "react-native-render-html";

// ...

const ignoreDomNode: TRenderEngineConfig["ignoreDomNode"] = (node) =>
  isDomElement(node) && !!node.attribs.class?.match(/hash-link/);

export default function WebEngine({ children }: React.PropsWithChildren<{}>) {
  // Every prop is defined outside of the function component.
  // This is important to prevent extraneous rebuilts of the engine.
  return (
    <TRenderEngineProvider
      ignoredDomTags={ignoredDomTags}
      selectDomRoot={selectDomRoot}
      ignoreDomNode={ignoreDomNode}
      // ...
    >
      {/*...*/}
    </TRenderEngineProvider>
  );
}
```

Great! Now the `#` characters have been removed.

Screenshot caption: Blog article body, code issue.

However, code samples look pretty ugly:

- They're missing padding;
- They should be horizontally scrollable and lines should not wrap;
- A monospace font should be used;
- Whitespaces should be preserved.

So, let's fix it!

#### Fixing Code Samples

Code samples are rendered by Docusaurus in a `<pre class="prism-code">` tag. We need to fix two issues:

- Define a custom renderer for `pre` tags, which renders inside a `ScrollView` when matching the `"prism-code"` class.
- Define a custom renderer for `span` tags. We need to do that because the whole code block is rendered inside a `code` element with a `display: flex; flex-direction: column`. However, `code` is translated to a React Native `Text` since his element model is **textual**. To work around this issue, we can inject line breaks after each `span` element with a CSS `token-line` class which content does not end with a new line.

```tsx title="components/WebEngine.tsx"
// ...other imports
import { TChildrenRenderer } from 'react-native-render-html';
import { ScrollView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';

// ...

const PreRenderer: CustomBlockRenderer = function PreRenderer({
  TDefaultRenderer,
  ...props
}) {
  if (props.tnode.hasClass("prism-code")) {
    return (
      <ScrollView horizontal style={props.style}>
        <TDefaultRenderer
          {...props}
          style={{ flexGrow: 1, flexShrink: 1, padding: 10 }}
        />
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }
  return <TDefaultRenderer {...props} />;
};

function tnodeEndsWithNewLine(tnode: TNode): boolean {
  if (tnode.type === "text") {
    return tnode.data.endsWith("\n");
  }
  const lastChild = tnode.children[tnode.children.length - 1];
  return lastChild ? tnodeEndsWithNewLine(lastChild) : false;
}

const SpanRenderer: CustomTextualRenderer = function SpanRenderer({
  TDefaultRenderer,
  ...props
}) {
  if (props.tnode.hasClass("token-line") && !tnodeEndsWithNewLine(props.tnode)) {
    return (
      <TDefaultRenderer {...props}>
        <TChildrenRenderer tchildren={props.tnode.children} />
        {"\n"}
      </TDefaultRenderer>
    );
  }
  return <TDefaultRenderer {...props} />;
};

const renderers: CustomTagRendererRecord = {
  // ... other renderers
  span: SpanRenderer,
  pre: PreRenderer,
};

const classesStyles: MixedStyleRecord = {
  // ... other classes styles
  "prism-code": {
    backgroundColor: "#282c34",
    fontFamily: "monospace",
    borderRadius: 10,
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 14 * 1.6,
    flexShrink: 0,
  },
};
```

Screenshot caption: Blog article body, code fixed.

That's looking much better. We're almost done!

#### Final Touch

We could add a few more styles to match the React Native blog styles:

```tsx title="components/WebEngine.tsx"
import {
  // ...
  MixedStyleDeclaration,
  // ...
} from "react-native-render-html";

// other imports and declarations

const tagsStyles: MixedStyleRecord = {
  a: {
    color: "#1c1e21",
    backgroundColor: "rgba(187, 239, 253, 0.3)",
  },
  li: {
    marginBottom: 10,
  },
  img: {
    alignSelf: "center",
  },
  h4: {
    marginBottom: 0,
    marginTop: 0,
  },
  code: {
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)",
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  blockquote: {
    marginLeft: 0,
    marginRight: 0,
    paddingLeft: 20,
    paddingRight: 20,
    backgroundColor: "#fff8d8",
    borderLeftWidth: 10,
    borderLeftColor: "#ffe564",
  },
};

const baseStyle: MixedStyleDeclaration = {
  color: "#1c1e21",
  fontSize: 16,
  lineHeight: 16 * 1.8,
};

export default function WebEngine({ children }: React.PropsWithChildren<{}>) {
  return (
    <TRenderEngineProvider
      // ...
      tagsStyles={tagsStyles}
      baseStyle={baseStyle}>
      {/*...*/}
    </TRenderEngineProvider>
  );
}
```

Screenshot caption: Blog article body, refined.

### Epilogue

#### Frustrating React Native Text Limitations

As a final note, I'd like to mention a few frustrating limitations in React Native that prevented me from replicating more accurately the official blog styles:

1. `backgroundColor` spans to the full line-box of text elements, whereas in CSS, it only spans to the text content-area. See a complete explanation [in this excellent article on CSS text styling](https://iamvdo.me/en/blog/css-font-metrics-line-height-and-vertical-align).
2. `padding` and `border` are ignored in nested text elements.

All these features are required to get the official blog appealing anchors styles. Instead we have backgrounds overlapping each other, which becomes weird when there is a high density of anchors. This is because, as stated before, the `backgroundColor` spans to the entire height of the line box, instead of spanning to the content area.

#### Going Further

You can take a look at the [`enhanced` branch of the project](https://github.com/jsamr/rnrh-blog/tree/enhanced) and see how the below features have been implemented:

- Cached queries with `react-queries`;
- Dark mode (follows system mode);
- Progressive rendering for fast time to first contentful paint via `FlatList`;
- Collapsible header with `react-native-reanimated` (v2);
- Video support with `expo-av`.

That's all for this tutorial! Don't forget to [give us a star](https://github.com/meliorence/react-native-render-html) if you enjoy this library. You can also [follow me on Twitter](https://twitter.com/jsamrn), and [rate this library on Open Base](https://openbase.com/js/react-native-render-html?utm_source=embedded&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=rate-badge).

# API Reference

Public-facing React API of the `@native-html/render` monorepo. This document
consolidates the user-facing components and hooks exported from the package:
the top-level `RenderHTML` component and its supporting providers
(`TRenderEngineProvider`, `RenderHTMLConfigProvider`, `RenderHTMLSource`), the
generic `TNodeRenderer` / `TNodeChildrenRenderer` building blocks for custom
renderers, the `IMGElement` family of components for advanced image rendering
customization, and the React hooks for accessing ambient render state
(`useSharedProps`, `useContentWidth`, `useRendererProps`,
`useDocumentMetadata`, etc.) plus the image state machines (`useIMGElementState`,
`useIMGElementStateWithCache`) and the `useInternalRenderer` escape hatch for
custom renderers.

## Components

React Components exported by this library.

### IMGElement

```ts
function IMGElement(props: IMGElementProps): ReactElement
```

A component to render images based on an internal loading state. It will
attempt to draw a box of paint dimensions before retrieving the physical
dimensions of the image to avoid layout shifts. See also `useIMGElementState`,
`IMGElementContainer`, `IMGElementContentSuccess`, `IMGElementContentLoading`
and `IMGElementContentError` for customization.

`IMGElementProps` extends `UseIMGElementStateProps` and adds:

- `containerProps?: Omit<ViewProps, 'style'>` — props forwarded to the outer
  container view.
- `onPress?: PressableProps['onPress']` — a callback triggered on press.
- `testID?: string` — test ID for the container.

Inherited from `UseIMGElementStateProps`:

- `alt?: string` — alt text extract from the `alt` attribute.
- `altColor?: string` — alt color; defaults to the `color` for this `TNode`.
- `cachedNaturalDimensions?: ImageDimensions` — natural ("physical")
  dimensions when known *a priori*. Saves an API call and filesystem access via
  `Image.getSize`.
- `computeMaxWidth?: (contentWidth: number) => number` — when provided, the
  print image will have a max width depending on the `contentWidth` prop.
- `contentWidth?: number` — the `contentWidth` from `RenderHTMLProps`.
- `enableExperimentalPercentWidth?: boolean` — allow experimental percent width
  for the print dimensions computation (relative to `contentWidth`).
- `height?: string | number` — value of the `height` attribute.
- `initialDimensions?: ImageDimensions` — rendered dimensions prior to
  retrieving natural dimensions of the image.
- `objectFit?: WebBlockStyles['objectFit']` — value of the `object-fit` CSS
  property.
- `source: ImageURISource` — the source to paint.
- `style?: StyleProp<ImageStyle>` — the style for this image.
- `width?: string | number` — value of the `width` attribute.

### IMGElementContainer

```ts
function IMGElementContainer(
  props: PropsWithChildren<
    Pick<IMGElementProps, 'onPress' | 'testID'> &
      Omit<ViewProps, 'style'> & { style: ViewStyle }
  >
): ReactElement
```

Container for the `IMGElement` component. Renders a `GenericPressable` if
`onPress` is provided, otherwise a plain `View`. The `style` is flattened so
that `width` / `height` are dropped from the container (delegated to the
inner image / placeholder).

### IMGElementContentAlt

```ts
function IMGElementContentAlt(
  props: PropsWithChildren<IMGElementStateBase & { testID?: string }>
): ReactElement
```

Alt view for the `IMGElement` component. Renders a `View` with
`accessibilityRole="image"` and an italic `Text` for the `alt` content.
Used as the fallback "image" view in error cases.

Key fields from `IMGElementStateBase`:
- `alt?: string`, `altColor?: string`, `containerStyle: ViewStyle`,
  `dimensions: ImageDimensions`, `source: ImageURISource`.

### IMGElementContentError

```ts
function IMGElementContentError(props: IMGElementStateError): ReactElement
```

Default error view for the `IMGElement` component. Internally renders
`IMGElementContentAlt` with `testID="image-error"`.

`IMGElementStateError` extends `IMGElementStateBase` with:
- `error: Error`
- `type: 'error'`

### IMGElementContentLoading

```ts
function IMGElementContentLoading(
  props: PropsWithChildren<IMGElementStateLoading>
): ReactElement
```

Default loading view for the `IMGElement` component. Renders a `View`
sized to `state.dimensions` with `testID="image-loading"`.

`IMGElementStateLoading` extends `IMGElementStateBase` with `type: 'loading'`.

### IMGElementContentSuccess

```ts
function IMGElementContentSuccess(props: IMGElementStateSuccess): ReactElement
```

Default success "image" view for the `IMGElement` component. Renders a
React Native `Image` with the merged `style = [defaultImageStyle, dimensions,
imageStyle]` and forwards image errors through `state.onError`.

`IMGElementStateSuccess` extends `IMGElementStateBase` with:
- `imageStyle: ImageStyle` — image-only style extracted from `IMGElement.style`.
- `onError: (error: Error) => void` — error callback for the underlying image.
- `type: 'success'`.

### RenderHTML

```ts
function RenderHTML(props: RenderHTMLProps): ReactElement
```

Render HTML text in native views. This is the top-level convenience
component; internally it composes `TRenderEngineProvider`,
`RenderHTMLConfigProvider`, and `RenderHTMLSource`.

> Remarks: If your application uses many instances of this component, you
> should share the render engine across those instances via the
> `TRenderEngineProvider` and `RenderHTMLConfigProvider` components, and
> render the HTML with `RenderHTMLSource` instead. That should significantly
> increase performance.

> Warning: It must never be a child of a React Native `Text` element, as the
> layout will break.

`RenderHTMLProps` is the union of three interfaces:
- `RenderHTMLConfig` — config consumed by `RenderHTMLConfigProvider`
  (extends `RenderHTMLSharedProps` + `RenderHTMLPassedProps`, plus
  `remoteErrorView`, `remoteLoadingView`, `renderers`).
- `RenderHTMLSourceProps` — `source`, `contentWidth`, `onHTMLLoaded`,
  `onTTreeChange`, `onDocumentMetadataLoaded`.
- `TRenderEngineConfig` — engine options such as `allowedStyles`,
  `baseStyle`, `classesStyles`, `customHTMLElementModels`,
  `domVisitors`, `emSize`, `enableCSSInlineProcessing`,
  `enableUserAgentStyles`, `fallbackFonts`, `htmlParserOptions`,
  `idsStyles`, `ignoreDomNode`, `ignoredDomTags`, `ignoredStyles`,
  `selectDomRoot`, `setMarkersForTNode`, `systemFonts`, `tagsStyles`,
  plus experimental flags.

Key `RenderHTMLSharedProps` (used everywhere via `useSharedProps`):
- `GenericPressable?: ComponentType<GenericPressableProps>` — wrapper for
  pressable elements (defaults to `TouchableNativeFeedback`-based on Android,
  `TouchableHighlight`-based elsewhere).
- `WebView?: ComponentType<any>` — WebView used by plugins; defaults to
  `() => null`.
- `bypassAnonymousTPhrasingNodes?: boolean` — when `true` (default), anonymous
  `TPhrasing` parents of a lonely `TText` are not wrapped in an extra `Text`.
- `computeEmbeddedMaxWidth?: (contentWidth: number, tagName: string) => number`
  — function returning a max width per tag. Defaults to `(c) => c`.
- `customListStyleSpecs?: Record<string, ListStyleSpec>` — extra list style
  type specs (see `@jsamr/counter-style`).
- `debug?: boolean` — log a `TDocument` snapshot after each TTree
  invalidation. Defaults to `false`.
- `defaultTextProps?: TextProps`, `defaultViewProps?: ViewProps`,
  `defaultWebViewProps?: any` — defaults for the corresponding native
  elements.
- `enableExperimentalBRCollapsing?: boolean` — follow HTML closely and
  ignore `<br>` closing an inline formatting context. Defaults `false`.
- `enableExperimentalGhostLinesPrevention?: boolean` — work around RN's
  20dpi blank line. Defaults `false`.
- `enableExperimentalMarginCollapsing?: boolean` — CSS margin collapsing.
  Defaults `false`.
- `pressableHightlightColor?: string` — ripple/highlight color.
  Defaults `rgba(38, 132, 240, 0.2)`.
- `provideEmbeddedHeaders?: EmbeddedHeadersProvider` — return per-URI
  request headers for embedded elements.

Key `RenderHTMLPassedProps`:
- `renderersProps?: Partial<RenderersProps>` — props consumed by custom
  renderers via `useRendererProps`. Augment via module declaration merging.

```tsx
import RenderHTML from '@native-html/render';

const source = { html: '<p>Hello <strong>world</strong></p>' };

export default function Page({ width }: { width: number }) {
  return <RenderHTML source={source} contentWidth={width} />;
}
```

### RenderHTMLConfigProvider

```ts
function RenderHTMLConfigProvider(
  props: PropsWithChildren<RenderHTMLConfig>
): ReactElement
```

Provides configuration for `RenderHTMLSource` descendants, to be used in
conjunction with `TRenderEngineProvider`. The split between the two
providers lets you share the heavy `TRenderEngine` instance while varying
shared/render config locally.

`RenderHTMLConfig` extends `RenderHTMLSharedProps` and `RenderHTMLPassedProps`
plus:
- `remoteErrorView?: (source: HTMLSourceUri) => ReactElement` — replace the
  default error display when remote content fails.
- `remoteLoadingView?: (source: HTMLSourceUri) => ReactElement` — replace the
  default loader for remote content.
- `renderers?: CustomTagRendererRecord` — record of custom tag renderers.

```tsx
import {
  TRenderEngineProvider,
  RenderHTMLConfigProvider,
  RenderHTMLSource
} from '@native-html/render';

function App() {
  return (
    <TRenderEngineProvider>
      <RenderHTMLConfigProvider>
        <RenderHTMLSource source={{ html: '<p>One</p>' }} contentWidth={360} />
        <RenderHTMLSource source={{ html: '<p>Two</p>' }} contentWidth={360} />
      </RenderHTMLConfigProvider>
    </TRenderEngineProvider>
  );
}
```

### RenderHTMLSource

```ts
const RenderHTMLSource: MemoExoticComponent<
  (props: RenderHTMLSourceProps) => ReactElement
>
```

A React component to render HTML snippets. Useful when you have to load
dozens of HTML snippets with the same config; performance is expected to
improve in such scenarios. Memoized: it re-renders only when `source` or
other props change by shallow equality.

> Warning: This component requires `TRenderEngineProvider` and
> `RenderHTMLConfigProvider` as parents.

`RenderHTMLSourceProps`:
- `source: HTMLSource` — the source to render. Discriminated union of
  `HTMLSourceInline ({ html, baseUrl? })`, `HTMLSourceUri ({ uri, method?,
  body?, headers? })`, or `HTMLSourceDom ({ dom, baseUrl? })`.
- `contentWidth?: number` — width of the content. Recommended:
  `useWindowDimensions().width` minus padding. Defaults to
  `Dimensions.get('window').width`.
- `onHTMLLoaded?: (html: string) => void` — invoked when HTML is available.
- `onTTreeChange?: (ttree: TDocument) => void` — invoked when the transient
  render tree changes.
- `onDocumentMetadataLoaded?: (metadata: DocumentMetadata) => void` —
  invoked when document metadata is available.

### TNodeChildrenRenderer

```ts
function TNodeChildrenRenderer(props: TNodeChildrenRendererProps): ReactElement
```

A component to render all children of a `TNode`. For `'text'` tnodes, it
returns the raw text data. Otherwise it delegates to `renderChildren` using
the props produced by `useTNodeChildrenProps`.

`TNodeChildrenRendererProps` extends `TChildrenBaseProps`:
- `tnode: TNode` — the parent tnode whose children should be rendered.
- `disableMarginCollapsing?: boolean` — opt-out of experimental margin
  collapsing for this collection.
- `propsForChildren?: Partial<PropsFromParent>` — propagated to children via
  `propsFromParent`.
- `renderChild?: (props: TChildProps) => ReactNode` — wrap each rendered
  child.

### TNodeRenderer

```ts
const TNodeRenderer: MemoExoticComponent<
  <T extends TNode>(props: TNodeRendererProps<T>) => ReactElement | null
>
```

A component to render any `TNode`. Internally dispatches by `tnode.type`
('block' / 'document' / 'text' / 'phrasing' / 'empty') and delegates either
to a registered internal renderer, a `TDefaultRenderer`, or to the textual
content / block content renderer functions.

`TNodeRendererProps<T extends TNode>`:
- `tnode: T` — the tnode to render.
- `renderIndex: number` — index relative to its React parent (not the same as
  `TNodeShape.index`).
- `renderLength: number` — total count of siblings in the React tree.
- `propsFromParent?: PropsFromParent` — props propagated by parents.

Also re-exports `TDefaultBlockRenderer`, `TDefaultPhrasingRenderer`,
`TDefaultTextRenderer`.

### TRenderEngineProvider

```ts
function TRenderEngineProvider(
  props: PropsWithChildren<TRenderEngineConfig>
): ReactElement
```

A React component to share a `TRenderEngine` instance across different
rendered contents via `RenderHTMLSource`. Significantly enhances performance
in applications with many distinct rendered snippets (e.g. chat apps).
Children consume the engine through `useAmbientTRenderEngine`.

Accepts all `TRenderEngineConfig` props described under `RenderHTML`
(e.g. `allowedStyles`, `baseStyle`, `tagsStyles`, `classesStyles`,
`idsStyles`, `customHTMLElementModels`, `enableCSSInlineProcessing`,
`enableUserAgentStyles`, `domVisitors`, `ignoredDomTags`, `ignoreDomNode`,
`htmlParserOptions`, `selectDomRoot`, `setMarkersForTNode`, `systemFonts`,
`fallbackFonts`, `emSize`, `dangerouslyDisableHoisting`,
`dangerouslyDisableWhitespaceCollapsing`).

## Hooks

React Hooks exported by this library.

### useAmbientTRenderEngine

```ts
function useAmbientTRenderEngine(): TRenderEngine
```

Use the ambient transient render engine. Returns the `TRenderEngine`
instance from the closest `TRenderEngineProvider`. In `__DEV__`, logs an
error if no provider is in the tree.

### useComputeMaxWidthForTag

```ts
function useComputeMaxWidthForTag(tagName: string): (cw: number) => number
```

Compute max width for a given tag, using
`RenderHTMLProps.computeEmbeddedMaxWidth` and
`RenderHTMLProps.contentWidth` under the hood. Returns a memoized callback
which, given a contentWidth, returns the maximum width for `tagName`.

### useContentWidth

```ts
function useContentWidth(): number | undefined
```

A hook to get access to the ambient `contentWidth` provided through
`contentWidthContext` (set by `RenderHTMLSource`).

### useDocumentMetadata

```ts
function useDocumentMetadata(): DocumentMetadata
```

Get access to the parsed HTML metadata anywhere in the render tree.

`DocumentMetadata` fields:
- `baseTarget: '_blank' | '_self' | '_parent' | '_top'` — default anchor
  target behavior.
- `baseUrl: string` — precedence: `<base />` element > `source.baseUrl` >
  origin of `source.uri`.
- `dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl'` — from `dir` attribute of `<html>`.
- `lang: string` — from `lang` attribute of `<html>`.
- `links: DocumentContext['links']` — array of attributes from `<link>` tags.
- `meta: DocumentContext['meta']` — array of attributes from `<meta>` tags.
- `title: string` — content of the `<title>` element.

### useIMGElementProps

```ts
function useIMGElementProps(
  props: InternalRendererProps<TBlock>
): IMGElementProps
```

A hook to produce props consumable by the `IMGElement` component from
custom renderer props. Internally calls `useContentWidth`,
`useRendererProps('img')`, `useComputeMaxWidthForTag('img')`,
`useNormalizedUrl(src)`, and `getNativePropsForTNode`. Extracts `alt`,
`altColor`, `width`, `height`, `objectFit` from the tnode attributes /
styles.

### useIMGElementState

```ts
function useIMGElementState(props: UseIMGElementStateProps): IMGElementState
```

Compute concrete dimensions from image natural dimensions and constraints.
It will fetch the image (via `Image.getSize` / `Image.getSizeWithHeaders`)
and get its dimensions.

> Remark: If you know the dimensions beforehand, use
> `useIMGElementStateWithCache` instead to save a network request and prevent
> a layout shift.

Returns `IMGElementState`, a tagged union:
- `IMGElementStateLoading` (`type: 'loading'`)
- `IMGElementStateSuccess` (`type: 'success'`, includes `onError`,
  `imageStyle`)
- `IMGElementStateError` (`type: 'error'`, includes `error: Error`)

All share `IMGElementStateBase`: `alt?`, `altColor?`, `containerStyle`,
`dimensions`, `source`.

### useIMGElementStateWithCache

```ts
function useIMGElementStateWithCache(
  props: UseIMGElementStateWithCacheProps
): IMGElementStateError | IMGElementStateSuccess
```

Useful when one has access to image natural dimensions prior to loading.
The `cachedNaturalDimensions` prop must be passed to immediately compute
concrete dimensions. Skips the loading state and the network roundtrip to
fetch image size.

`UseIMGElementStateWithCacheProps = UseIMGElementStateProps &
Required<Pick<UseIMGElementStateProps, 'cachedNaturalDimensions'>>`.

### useInternalRenderer

```ts
function useInternalRenderer<T extends TagName>(
  tagName: T,
  props: InternalRendererProps<any>
): T extends InternalSpecialRenderedTag
  ? InternalRendererConfig<ReturnType<(typeof specialRenderersConfig)[T]['hook']>>
  : InternalRendererConfig<TDefaultRendererProps<any>>
```

Reuse internal renderers logic for infinite customization.

> Remark: `tagName` must be invariant — it cannot change. You would otherwise
> break the rules of hooks.

Parameters:
- `tagName` — **invariant** tag name to extend. The four special tags with
  dedicated hooks/elements are `img`, `ol`, `ul`, `a`.
- `props` — the props passed to the custom renderer.

Returns `InternalRendererConfig<P>`:
- `Renderer: ComponentType<P>` — the internal React component (e.g.
  `IMGElement`, `OLElement`, `ULElement`) or `TDefaultRenderer` for other
  tags.
- `rendererProps: P` — the props prepared by the corresponding internal hook
  (e.g. `useIMGElementProps`).

### useNormalizedUrl

```ts
function useNormalizedUrl(initialUrl: string): string
```

Transforms relative and protocol-relative URLs to absolute URLs as per
RFC1808. The base URL is determined by the `<base />` element, `source.uri`
or `source.baseUrl`.

> Remarks:
> - If there is no `baseUrl` and the initial URL is relative, this hook
>   returns the initial URL.
> - If the initial URL is absolute, this hook returns the initial URL.

### useRendererProps

```ts
function useRendererProps<
  RendererProps extends RenderersProps = RenderersProps,
  K extends keyof RendererProps = keyof RendererProps
>(tagName: K): RendererProps[K]
```

Consume props from `RenderHTMLProps.renderersProps` for the given tag name.
Inside custom renderers this is the canonical way to read user-supplied
config (e.g. `renderersProps.img`, `renderersProps.a.onPress`).

Built-in keys on `RenderersProps`:
- `a: AElementConfig` — anchor element config (`onPress`).
- `img: ImgElementConfig` — image element config
  (`enableExperimentalPercentWidth`, `initialDimensions`).
- `ol: ListElementConfig`, `ul: ListElementConfig` — list element config
  (`enableDynamicMarkerBoxWidth`, `enableExperimentalRtl`,
  `enableRemoveBottomMarginIfNested`, `enableRemoveTopMarginIfNested`,
  `getFallbackListStyleTypeFromNestLevel`, `markerBoxStyle`,
  `markerTextStyle`).

> TypeScript users: extend `RenderersProps` via module augmentation:

```ts
declare module '@native-html/render' {
  interface RenderersProps {
    div?: {
      customProp: boolean;
    };
  }
}
```

### useSharedProps

```ts
function useSharedProps(): RenderHTMLAmbiantSharedProps
```

Use shared props for the surrounding `RenderHTML`/`RenderHTMLConfigProvider`
tree (see `RenderHTMLSharedProps`). Returns a memoized object with all
shared options (e.g. `debug`, `defaultTextProps`, `defaultViewProps`,
`computeEmbeddedMaxWidth`, `enableExperimentalMarginCollapsing`,
`customListStyleSpecs`, etc.).

### useTNodeChildrenProps

```ts
function useTNodeChildrenProps(
  props: TNodeChildrenRendererProps
): TChildrenRendererProps
```

Especially useful when one needs to tamper with children in a custom
renderer. Should be used with `TChildrenRenderer`. It computes whether
margin collapsing should apply (based on the experimental flag and tnode
type) and returns props ready to feed `TChildrenRenderer`.

Example — a custom renderer which inserts ads in an article:

```tsx
function ArticleRenderer(props) {
  const { tnode, TDefaultRenderer, ...defaultRendererProps } = props;
  const tchildrenProps = useTNodeChildrenProps(props);
  const firstChildrenChunk = tnode.children.slice(0, 2);
  const secondChildrenChunk = tnode.children.slice(2, 4);
  const thirdChildrenChunk = tnode.children.slice(4, 5);
  return (
    <TDefaultRenderer tnode={tnode} {...defaultRendererProps}>
      <TChildrenRenderer {...tchildrenProps} tchildren={firstChildrenChunk} />
      {firstChildrenChunk.length === 2 ? <AdComponent /> : null}
      <TChildrenRenderer {...tchildrenProps} tchildren={secondChildrenChunk} />
      {secondChildrenChunk.length === 2 ? <AdComponent /> : null}
      <TChildrenRenderer {...tchildrenProps} tchildren={thirdChildrenChunk} />
    </TDefaultRenderer>
  );
}
```

`TChildrenRendererProps` extends `TChildrenBaseProps`:
- `tchildren: ReadonlyArray<TNode>` — children to render.
- `disableMarginCollapsing?`, `propsForChildren?`, `renderChild?` — inherited
  from `TChildrenBaseProps`.

**Scope:** TypeScript types and internal/utility exports of the `@native-html/render` monorepo: TNode shape, element models, content models, renderer props/records, CSS prop-key types and processor config, image-state types, tag-name constants, and other helper exports.

## TRE Types

Transient Render Engine types: the `TNode` tree, content/element models, and TStyles shapes.

### TNode

```ts
type TNode = TBlock | TDocument | TEmpty | TPhrasing | TText;
```

A transient render node — a ready-to-render data structure produced by the TRE.

### TNodeType

```ts
type TNodeType = 'block' | 'phrasing' | 'text' | 'empty' | 'document';
```

Discriminant literal for `TNodeShape`.

### TNodeShape

Shared properties for all `TNode` types. Parameterized by the literal type.

```ts
interface TNodeShape<T extends TNodeType> {
  readonly attributes: Record<string, string>;
  readonly id: string | null;
  readonly classes: string[];
  readonly domNode: Element | null;
  readonly tagName: string | null;             // null for anonymous hoist nodes / some TText
  readonly parent: TDocument | TBlock | TPhrasing | null; // before hoisting
  readonly nodeIndex: number;                  // position after hoisting/collapsing
  readonly children: ReadonlyArray<TNode>;
  readonly displayName: string;                // debug
  readonly type: T;
  readonly isUnregistered: boolean;            // true when tag is unknown + no custom renderer
  readonly markers: Readonly<Markers>;
  readonly styles: TStylesShape;               // raw; prefer getNativeStyles()
  snapshot(options?: Partial<TNodePrintOptions>): string;
  hasClass(className: string): boolean;
  matchContentModel(contentModel: HTMLContentModel): boolean;
  getNativeStyles(): T extends 'text' | 'phrasing' ? NativeTextStyles : NativeBlockStyles;
  getWebStyles(): WebTextStyles & WebBlockStyles;
  getReactNativeProps: () => ReactNativePropsSwitch | null;
}
```

Markers are immutable and may be reference-shared from parent to child.

### TBlock

```ts
interface TBlock extends TNodeShape<'block'> {
  readonly tagName: string;
  readonly domNode: Element;
}
```

Transient render node rendered as a React Native `View`.

### TPhrasing

```ts
interface TPhrasing extends TNodeShape<'phrasing'> {}
```

Rendered in React Native `Text`. Children are `TText`, `TPhrasing`, or `TEmpty`.

### TText

```ts
interface TText extends TNodeShape<'text'> {
  readonly data: string;
  readonly textNode: Text;
}
```

Leaf textual node. Rendered in React Native `Text`.

### TDocument

```ts
interface TDocument extends TNodeShape<'document'> {
  readonly context: Readonly<DocumentContext>;
}
```

Root of a transient render tree, with metadata about the document.

### TEmpty

```ts
interface TEmpty extends TNodeShape<'empty'> {
  readonly domNode: Element;
}
```

Non-renderable element (content model = `none`).

### TNodeDescriptor

A minimal TNode shape accessible at instantiation — passed to `SetMarkersForTNode` and `getMixedUAStyles`.

```ts
interface TNodeDescriptor {
  readonly attributes: Record<string, string>;
  readonly id: string | null;
  readonly classes: string[];
  readonly domNode: Element | null;
  readonly tagName: string | null;
  readonly markers: Readonly<Markers>;
  hasClass(className: string): boolean;
}
```

### TNodePrintOptions

```ts
interface TNodePrintOptions {
  withStyles: boolean;
  withNodeIndex: boolean;
}
```

Options for `TNodeShape.snapshot()`.

### ExtractTNodeFromType

```ts
type ExtractTNodeFromType<Type> = Type extends TNodeType
  ? Type extends 'block' ? TBlock
  : Type extends 'phrasing' ? TPhrasing
  : Type extends 'text' ? TText
  : Type extends 'empty' ? TEmpty
  : Type extends 'document' ? TDocument
  : never
  : never;
```

### DocumentContext

Metadata extracted from the `<head>` tag, attached to `TDocument`.

```ts
interface DocumentContext {
  charset: string;
  baseHref: string;
  baseTarget: '_blank' | '_self' | '_parent' | '_top';
  lang: string;
  dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl';
  title: string;
  meta: { name: string; value: string }[];
  links: Record<string, string>[];
}
```

### Markers

```ts
interface Markers {
  anchor: boolean;                          // default false
  edits: 'ins' | 'del' | 'none';            // default 'none'
  direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl';                 // default 'ltr'
  lang: string;
  olNestLevel: number;                      // -1 when not in an ol
  ulNestLevel: number;                      // -1 when not in a ul
  extend(this: Markers): Markers;
  toString(): string;
}
```

Markers form an abstraction in which one node provides semantic information to itself and all its descendants (e.g. `<ins>` provides `{edits: 'ins'}`). Custom renderers consume them to convey semantic meaning. The shape can be extended via module augmentation.

> Treat as immutable. Marker instances may be shared from parent to children for performance.

### SetMarkersForTNode

```ts
type SetMarkersForTNode = (
  targetMarkers: Markers,
  parentMarkers: Readonly<Markers>,
  tnode: TNodeDescriptor,
) => void;
```

Function called during tree construction to mutate the `targetMarkers` of a node.

### HTMLContentModel

```ts
enum HTMLContentModel {
  block = 'block',       // → TBlock
  textual = 'textual',   // → TPhrasing or TText
  mixed = 'mixed',       // → TBlock, TPhrasing or TText
  none = 'none',         // → TEmpty
}
```

Determines how a tag is translated into the transient render tree.

### ElementCategory

```ts
type ElementCategory =
  | 'anchor' | 'textual' | 'tabular' | 'edits' | 'embedded'
  | 'sectioning' | 'grouping' | 'interactive' | 'untranslatable';
```

HTML5-derived classification used by `NativeElementModel`.

### ElementModelBase

The base shape for all element models — both native (built-in HTML) and custom.

```ts
interface ElementModelBase<T extends string> {
  readonly tagName: T;
  readonly isOpaque?: boolean;             // translated TNode has no children
  readonly isVoid?: boolean;               // void elements (br, img, hr...)
  readonly mixedUAStyles?: MixedStyleDeclaration;
  readonly reactNativeProps?: ReactNativePropsDefinitions;
  setMarkersForTNode?: SetMarkersForTNode;
  /** @deprecated use getMixedUAStyles */
  getUADerivedStyleFromAttributes?: (
    attributes: Record<string, string>, markers: Markers,
  ) => MixedStyleDeclaration | null;
  getMixedUAStyles?: (
    tnode: TNodeDescriptor, element: Element,
  ) => MixedStyleDeclaration | null | undefined | void;
  getReactNativeProps?: (
    tnode: ExtractTNodeFromType<TNodeType>,
    preGeneratedProps: ReactNativePropsSwitch | null,
    element: Element,
  ) => ReactNativePropsDefinitions | null | undefined | void;
}
```

`getReactNativeProps` merge order (latest wins): `reactNativeProps` → auto-generated-from-attributes → return value.

### NativeElementModel

```ts
interface NativeElementModel<T extends string = TagName, C = ElementCategory>
  extends ElementModelBase<T> {
  readonly category: C;
}
```

Spec for tags belonging to the HTML4/HTML5 standard.

### CustomElementModel

```ts
interface CustomElementModel<T extends string, M extends HTMLContentModel>
  extends ElementModelBase<T> {
  readonly contentModel: M;
  readonly tagName: T;
}
```

Spec used with `HTMLElementModel.fromCustomModel()`.

### HTMLElementModelShape

```ts
interface HTMLElementModelShape<T extends string, M extends HTMLContentModel>
  extends ElementModelBase<T> {
  readonly contentModel: M;
  readonly isVoid: boolean;
  readonly isOpaque: boolean;
}
```

### HTMLElementModel (class)

Engine internals for tags — default styles (UAStyles), content model, hoisting behavior.

```ts
class HTMLElementModel<T extends string, M extends HTMLContentModel>
  implements HTMLElementModelShape<T, M> {
  readonly tagName: T;
  readonly contentModel: M;
  readonly isOpaque: boolean;
  readonly isVoid: boolean;
  readonly mixedUAStyles?: MixedStyleDeclaration;
  readonly reactNativeProps?: ReactNativePropsDefinitions;
  readonly getUADerivedStyleFromAttributes: NativeElementModel['getUADerivedStyleFromAttributes'];
  readonly getMixedUAStyles: NativeElementModel['getMixedUAStyles'];
  readonly getReactNativeProps: NativeElementModel['getReactNativeProps'];
  readonly setMarkersForTNode?: SetMarkersForTNode;

  static fromCustomModel<CT extends string, CM extends HTMLContentModel>(
    template: CustomElementModel<CT, CM>,
  ): HTMLElementModel<CT, CM>;

  static fromNativeModel<TN extends TagName, E extends ElementCategory>(
    nativeElementModel: NativeElementModel<TN, E>,
  ): HTMLElementModel<TN,
        E extends 'anchor' | 'edits' ? HTMLContentModel.mixed
      : E extends 'tabular' | 'sectioning' | 'grouping' ? HTMLContentModel.block
      : E extends 'textual' ? HTMLContentModel.textual
      : HTMLContentModel.none>;

  isTranslatableBlock(): boolean;
  isTranslatableTextual(): boolean;

  extend<CM extends HTMLContentModel>(
    merger: (shape: HTMLElementModelShape<T, CM>) => Partial<HTMLElementModelShape<T, CM>>,
  ): HTMLElementModel<T, CM>;
  extend<CM extends HTMLContentModel>(
    shape: Partial<HTMLElementModelShape<T, CM>>,
  ): HTMLElementModel<T, CM>;
}
```

### HTMLElementModelRecord

```ts
type HTMLElementModelRecord = Record<string, HTMLElementModel<string, HTMLContentModel>>;
```

### HTMLModelRecord

```ts
type HTMLModelRecord<T extends string = TagName, M extends HTMLContentModel = HTMLContentModel>
  = { [k in T]: HTMLElementModel<k, M> };
```

### TStylesShape

A record of styles organized in logical chunks: native vs web, block vs text target, flow (inheritable) vs retain (non-inheritable).

```ts
interface TStylesShape {
  readonly nativeTextFlow:  CSSProcessedProps['native']['text']['flow'];
  readonly nativeBlockFlow: CSSProcessedProps['native']['block']['flow'];
  readonly nativeTextRet:   CSSProcessedProps['native']['text']['retain'];
  readonly nativeBlockRet:  CSSProcessedProps['native']['block']['retain'];
  readonly webTextFlow:     CSSProcessedProps['web']['text']['flow'];
  readonly webBlockRet:     CSSProcessedProps['web']['block']['retain'];
}
```

### NativeBlockStyles / NativeTextStyles / WebBlockStyles / WebTextStyles

Processed style aliases derived from `TStylesShape`:

```ts
type NativeBlockStyles = TStylesShape['nativeBlockFlow'] & TStylesShape['nativeBlockRet'];
type NativeTextStyles  = TStylesShape['nativeBlockFlow'] & TStylesShape['nativeBlockRet']
                      & TStylesShape['nativeTextFlow']  & TStylesShape['nativeTextRet'];
type WebTextStyles     = TStylesShape['webTextFlow'];
type WebBlockStyles    = TStylesShape['webBlockRet'];
```

### TRenderEngine (class)

```ts
class TRenderEngine {
  constructor(options?: TRenderEngineOptions);
  parseDocument(html: string): Document;
  buildTTreeFromDoc(document: Document | Element): TDocument;
  buildTTree(html: string): TDocument;
  getHTMLElementsModels(): HTMLModelRecord<string>;
}
```

### TRenderEngineOptions

Options passed to the `TRenderEngine` constructor.

```ts
interface TRenderEngineOptions<E extends string = never> {
  readonly cssProcessorConfig?: Partial<CSSProcessorConfig>;
  readonly htmlParserOptions?: Readonly<HTMLParserOptions>;
  readonly stylesConfig?: StylesConfig;
  readonly customizeHTMLModels?: (defaults: DefaultHTMLElementModelsStatic) => HTMLModelRecord<TagName | E>;
  readonly removeLineBreaksAroundEastAsianDiscardSet?: boolean; // default false
  readonly ignoredDomTags?: string[];
  readonly domVisitors?: DomVisitorCallbacks;
  readonly ignoreDomNode?: (node: Node, parent: NodeWithChildren) => boolean | void | unknown;
  readonly selectDomRoot?: (node: NodeWithChildren) => any;
  readonly setMarkersForTNode?: SetMarkersForTNode;
  readonly dangerouslyDisableHoisting?: boolean;
  readonly dangerouslyDisableWhitespaceCollapsing?: boolean;
}
```

### TRenderEngineConfig

Configuration for the `TRenderEngineProvider` React component (a superset of `TRenderEngineOptions` exposed through props).

```ts
interface TRenderEngineConfig {
  allowedStyles?: CSSPropertyNameList;
  baseStyle?: MixedStyleDeclaration;
  classesStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;
  customHTMLElementModels?: HTMLElementModelRecord;
  dangerouslyDisableHoisting?: boolean;
  dangerouslyDisableWhitespaceCollapsing?: boolean;
  domVisitors?: DomVisitorCallbacks;
  emSize?: number;
  enableCSSInlineProcessing?: boolean;       // default true
  enableUserAgentStyles?: boolean;           // default true
  fallbackFonts?: FallbackFontsDefinitions;
  htmlParserOptions?: HtmlParserOptions;     // default { decodeEntities: true }
  idsStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;
  ignoreDomNode?: (node: Node, parent: NodeWithChildren) => boolean | void | unknown;
  ignoredDomTags?: string[];
  ignoredStyles?: CSSPropertyNameList;
  selectDomRoot?: TRenderEngineOptions['selectDomRoot'];
  setMarkersForTNode?: SetMarkersForTNode;
  systemFonts?: string[];
  tagsStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;
}
```

> Warning: any change to these props rebuilds the engine and re-assembles all transient trees.

### StylesConfig

```ts
interface StylesConfig {
  readonly tagsStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;     // specificity 1
  readonly classesStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;  // specificity 10
  readonly idsStyles?: MixedStyleRecord;      // specificity 100
  readonly baseStyle?: Readonly<MixedStyleDeclaration>;
  readonly enableCSSInlineProcessing?: boolean;
  readonly enableUserAgentStyles?: boolean;
}
```

### MixedStyleRecord

```ts
type MixedStyleRecord<T extends string = string> = Readonly<Record<T, MixedStyleDeclaration>>;
```

### DomVisitorCallbacks

```ts
interface DomVisitorCallbacks {
  onDocument?(document: Document): void;
  onElement?(element: Element): void;
  onText?(text: Text): void;
}
```

### DefaultHTMLElementModelsStatic

```ts
type DefaultHTMLElementModelsStatic = typeof defaultHTMLElementModels;
```

A typed record of all built-in `HTMLElementModel` instances keyed by lowercase tag name, with the correct `HTMLContentModel` literal for each. Examples:

```ts
{
  a:    HTMLElementModel<'a',    HTMLContentModel.mixed>;
  div:  HTMLElementModel<'div',  HTMLContentModel.block>;
  span: HTMLElementModel<'span', HTMLContentModel.textual>;
  img:  HTMLElementModel<'img',  HTMLContentModel.block>;
  br:   HTMLElementModel<'br',   HTMLContentModel.textual>;
  link: HTMLElementModel<'link', HTMLContentModel.none>;
  // ...all HTML4/HTML5 tags supported by TRE
}
```

## CSS Types

Types and configuration coming from `@native-html/css-processor`. The naming scheme classifies each property along three axes:

- **Compat:** `native` (passed to RN `style` props) vs `web` (TRE-only).
- **Display:** `text` vs `block` target.
- **Propagation:** `flow` (inherits) vs `retain` (own only).

Plus shape: long-hand vs short-hand, translatable vs untranslatable.

### CSSProperties

```ts
type CSSProperties = Record<string, any>;
```

### CSSPropertyCompatCategory

```ts
type CSSPropertyCompatCategory = 'native' | 'web';
```

### CSSPropertyDisplayCategory

```ts
type CSSPropertyDisplayCategory = 'text' | 'block';
```

### CSSPropertyPropagationCategory

```ts
type CSSPropertyPropagationCategory = 'flow' | 'retain';
```

### CSSPropagationRegistry

```ts
type CSSPropagationRegistry = Record<CSSPropertyPropagationCategory, CSSProperties>;
```

### CSSDisplayRegistry

```ts
type CSSDisplayRegistry = Record<CSSPropertyDisplayCategory, CSSPropagationRegistry>;
```

### CSSPropertySpecs

```ts
interface CSSPropertySpecs<
  C extends CSSPropertyCompatCategory = CSSPropertyCompatCategory,
  D extends CSSPropertyDisplayCategory = CSSPropertyDisplayCategory,
  P extends CSSPropertyPropagationCategory = CSSPropertyPropagationCategory
> {
  readonly compatCategory: C;
  readonly displayCategory: D;
  readonly propagationCategory: P;
}
```

### CSSProcessorConfig

```ts
interface CSSProcessorConfig {
  readonly absoluteLengthUnitsMultiplicators: CSSAbsoluteLengthUnitsMultiplicators;
  readonly absoluteBorderWidthsPixelMap: Record<CSSHardcodedBorderWidth, number>;
  readonly relativeFontSizesCoefficientMap: Record<CSSRelativeHarcodedFontSize, number>;
  readonly absoluteFontSizesPixelMap: Record<CSSAbsoluteHardcodedFontSize, number>;
  readonly inlinePropertiesBlacklist: CSSPropertyNameList;
  readonly inlinePropertiesWhitelist: CSSPropertyNameList | null;
  readonly rootFontSize: number;
  readonly skipFontFamilyValidation?: boolean;
  isFontSupported(fontName: string): boolean | string;
}
```

### CSSPropertyNameList

```ts
type CSSPropertyNameList = Array<
  CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey | CSSLongNativeTranslatableTextPropKey
>;
```

Used by `allowedStyles` / `ignoredStyles`.

### CSSLengthUnit

```ts
type CSSLengthUnit =
  | 'cm' | 'mm' | 'in' | 'px' | 'pt' | 'pc'
  | 'em' | 'ex' | 'ch' | 'rem'
  | 'vw' | 'vh' | 'vmin' | 'vmax' | '%';
```

### CSSAbsoluteLengthUnit

```ts
type CSSAbsoluteLengthUnit = Extract<CSSLengthUnit, 'in' | 'cm' | 'mm' | 'px' | 'pt' | 'pc'>;
```

### CSSAbsoluteLengthUnitsMultiplicators

```ts
type CSSAbsoluteLengthUnitsMultiplicators = Record<Exclude<CSSAbsoluteLengthUnit, 'px'>, number>;
```

### CSSHardcodedBorderWidth

```ts
type CSSHardcodedBorderWidth = 'thin' | 'medium' | 'thick';
```

### CSSAbsoluteHardcodedFontSize

```ts
type CSSAbsoluteHardcodedFontSize =
  'xx-small' | 'x-small' | 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'x-large' | 'xx-large';
```

### CSSRelativeHarcodedFontSize

```ts
type CSSRelativeHarcodedFontSize = 'smaller' | 'larger';
```

### CSSListStyleTypePropertyBase

A long union covering all `list-style-type` values: `none`, `disc`, `circle`, `square`, the decimal/roman/alpha series, all CJK forms, hebrew/armenian/georgian, devanagari, ethiopic-numeric, and many more — see source `processor-types.d.ts` for the full list.

### MixedStyleDeclaration

A style object that mixes a subset of `ViewStyle`, `TextStyle`, and special entries such as `whiteSpace` / `listStyleType`. Sizes (`fontSize`, `borderWidth`, etc.) accept numbers or CSS strings with units (em, rem, %, keywords like `larger`/`thin`).

```ts
type MixedStyleDeclaration =
    Omit<CSSFlattenProcessedTypes, MixedSizeCSSPropertiesKeys>
  & WebTextFlowProperties
  & WebBlockRetainProperties
  & ExtraNativeTextStyle
  & ExtraNativeViewStyle
  & ExtraNativeShortStyle
  & ExtraNativeUntranslatedLongStyles
  & { [k in MixedSizeCSSPropertiesKeys]?: number | string };
```

### CSSFlattenProcessedTypes

```ts
type CSSFlattenProcessedTypes =
    CSSProcessedProps['native']['text']['flow']
  & CSSProcessedProps['native']['block']['flow']
  & CSSProcessedProps['native']['text']['retain']
  & CSSProcessedProps['native']['block']['retain'];
```

All processed inline-style outputs flattened.

### MixedSizeCSSPropertiesKeys

```ts
type MixedSizeCSSPropertiesKeys =
  | 'fontSize' | 'borderWidth' | 'letterSpacing'
  | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'top' | 'right'
  | 'width' | 'height' | 'flexBasis'
  | 'borderRadius' | 'borderBottomLeftRadius' | 'borderBottomRightRadius'
  | 'borderTopLeftRadius' | 'borderTopRightRadius'
  | 'borderBottomWidth' | 'borderLeftWidth' | 'borderRightWidth'
  | 'marginBottom' | 'marginLeft' | 'marginRight' | 'marginTop'
  | 'margin' | 'marginHorizontal' | 'marginVertical'
  | 'maxWidth' | 'maxHeight' | 'minWidth' | 'minHeight'
  | 'padding' | 'paddingBottom' | 'paddingLeft' | 'paddingRight' | 'paddingTop'
  | 'paddingHorizontal' | 'paddingVertical';
```

These accept CSS unit strings as well as numbers.

### WebTextFlowProperties

```ts
interface WebTextFlowProperties extends Partial<Record<CSSLongWebTextFlowedPropKey, any>> {
  whiteSpace?: 'normal' | 'pre';
  listStyleType?: CSSListStyleTypePropertyBase | string;
}
```

### WebBlockRetainProperties

```ts
interface WebBlockRetainProperties {
  objectFit?: 'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'none' | 'scale-down';
}
```

### NativeTextStyleKey

```ts
type NativeTextStyleKey = Exclude<keyof TextStyle, keyof ViewStyle>;
```

Keys that are exclusive to RN `TextStyle`.

### CSSShortPropsKey

```ts
type CSSShortPropsKey = Extract<keyof StandardShorthandProperties,
  'background' | 'border' | 'borderColor' | 'borderRadius' | 'borderWidth'
  | 'flex' | 'flexFlow' | 'font' | 'margin' | 'padding' | 'textDecoration'>;
```

Shorthand properties pre-translated via css-to-react-native.

### CSSShortTextPropKey

```ts
type CSSShortTextPropKey = Extract<CSSShortPropsKey, 'textDecoration' | 'font'>;
```

### CSSShortBlockPropKey

```ts
type CSSShortBlockPropKey = Exclude<CSSShortPropsKey, CSSShortTextPropKey>;
```

### CSSShortNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey

```ts
type CSSShortNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey = Exclude<CSSShortPropsKey, CSSShortTextPropKey>;
```

### CSSFlowedPropKey

Long-hand inheritable CSS keys.

```ts
type CSSFlowedPropKey = Extract<keyof StandardLonghandProperties,
  'borderCollapse' | 'borderSpacing' | 'captionSide' | 'color' | 'cursor' | 'direction'
  | 'emptyCells' | 'fontFamily' | 'fontSize' | 'fontStyle' | 'fontVariant' | 'fontWeight'
  | 'font' | 'letterSpacing' | 'lineHeight' | 'listStyleImage' | 'listStylePosition'
  | 'listStyleType' | 'listStyle' | 'orphans' | 'quotes' | 'textAlign' | 'textIndent'
  | 'textTransform' | 'visibility' | 'whiteSpace' | 'widows' | 'wordSpacing'>;
```

### CSSLongNativeTextPropKey

```ts
type CSSLongNativeTextPropKey = Extract<keyof StandardLonghandProperties,
  Exclude<NativeTextStyleKey, CSSUnimplementedNativePropKey>>;
```

### CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey

```ts
type CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey = Extract<keyof StandardLonghandProperties | 'borderStyle',
  Exclude<keyof ViewStyle, CSSUnimplementedNativePropKey>>;
```

### CSSNativePropKey

```ts
type CSSNativePropKey =
  CSSLongNativeTextPropKey | CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey | CSSShortPropsKey;
```

### Misc CSS prop-key alias unions

These are pure boolean combinations of the above (`Extract` / `Exclude` of long/short × native/web × translatable/untranslatable × text/block × flow/retain):

- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableTextPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeTextPropKey, CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextPropKey` — `never` (no untranslatable text long-hands today).
- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableTextFlowedPropKey` — `Extract<CSSLongNativeTextPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableTextRetainedPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeTextPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextFlowedPropKey` — `Extract<CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextRetainedPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeUntranslatableTextPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey, CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockPropKey` — `Extract<CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey, 'position'>`.
- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockFlowedPropKey` — `Extract<CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockRetainedPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeTranslatableBlockPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockFlowedPropKey` — `Extract<CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockRetainedPropKey` — `Exclude<CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockPropKey, CSSFlowedPropKey>`.
- `CSSLongWebTextFlowedPropKey` — `Extract<keyof StandardLonghandProperties, 'whiteSpace' | 'listStyleType' | 'userSelect'>`.
- `CSSLongWebTextRetainedPropKey` — `Extract<keyof StandardLonghandProperties, never>` (currently empty).

### Native style extras

```ts
type ExtendedNativeViewStyleKeys = keyof ViewStyle | keyof ImageStyle;

type NativeDirectionalStyleKeys = Extract<ExtendedNativeViewStyleKeys,
  'borderBottomEndRadius' | 'borderBottomStartRadius' | 'borderTopEndRadius' | 'borderTopStartRadius'
  | 'borderEndColor' | 'borderEndWidth' | 'borderStartColor' | 'borderStartWidth'
  | 'marginEnd' | 'marginStart' | 'paddingEnd' | 'paddingStart' | 'start' | 'end'>;

type ExtraNativeShortViewStyleKeys = Extract<ExtendedNativeViewStyleKeys,
  'marginHorizontal' | 'marginVertical' | 'paddingHorizontal' | 'paddingVertical'>;

type ExtraNativeLongViewStyleKeys = Exclude<
  Exclude<ExtendedNativeViewStyleKeys, CSSShortPropsKey>,
  CSSLongNativeBlockPropKey | CSSUnimplementedNativePropKey
  | NativeDirectionalStyleKeys | ExtraNativeShortViewStyleKeys
>;

type ExtraNativeTextStyleKeys = Exclude<
  Exclude<NativeTextStyleKey, CSSShortPropsKey>,
  CSSLongNativeTextPropKey | CSSUnimplementedNativePropKey
>;

type NativeShortKeys = Extract<CSSShortPropsKey, NativeTextStyleKey | keyof ViewStyle>;

type ExtraNativeShortStyle = Pick<TextStyle & ViewStyle, ExtraNativeShortViewStyleKeys | NativeShortKeys>;
type ExtraNativeTextStyle  = Partial<Pick<TextStyle, ExtraNativeTextStyleKeys>>;
type ExtraNativeViewStyle  = Partial<Pick<ViewStyle & ImageStyle, ExtraNativeLongViewStyleKeys | ExtraNativeShortViewStyleKeys>>;
type ExtraNativeUntranslatedLongStyles = Pick<ViewStyle, CSSLongNativeUntranslatableBlockPropKey>;
```

These cover RN-specific style keys that lie outside the standard CSS prop-key partitions (directional logical properties, horizontal/vertical shorthands, etc.) so they can still be carried through `MixedStyleDeclaration`.

## Renderer Types

Props passed to default, internal, and custom renderers. Types live in `@native-html/render`.

### TNodeRendererProps

```ts
interface TNodeRendererProps<T extends TNode> {
  propsFromParent?: PropsFromParent;
  renderIndex: number;          // React-tree index, after hoisting
  renderLength: number;         // total React-tree siblings
  tnode: T;
}
```

### RendererBaseProps

Abstract base for renderer prop interfaces.

```ts
interface RendererBaseProps<T extends TNode> extends TNodeRendererProps<T> {
  nativeProps?: StylessReactNativeProps & { style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle> };
  onPress?: (e: GestureResponderEvent) => void;
  textProps: TextProps;
  type: 'text' | 'block';
  viewProps: ViewProps;
}
```

`nativeProps.style`, `textProps.style`, `viewProps.style` have higher specificity than the TNode's computed styles.

### TDefaultRendererProps

```ts
interface TDefaultRendererProps<T extends TNode> extends RendererBaseProps<T> {
  TNodeChildrenRenderer: ComponentType<TNodeChildrenRendererProps>;
  children?: ReactNode;
  propsForChildren?: Partial<PropsFromParent>;
  style: T extends TText | TPhrasing
    ? StyleProp<TextStyle>
    : StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}
```

### InternalRendererProps

```ts
interface InternalRendererProps<T extends TNode> extends RendererBaseProps<T> {
  TDefaultRenderer: TDefaultRenderer<T>;
  TNodeChildrenRenderer: ComponentType<TNodeChildrenRendererProps>;
  sharedProps: RenderHTMLAmbiantSharedProps;
  style: T extends TText | TPhrasing ? NativeTextStyles : NativeBlockStyles;
}
```

### CustomRendererProps

```ts
interface CustomRendererProps<T extends TNode> extends InternalRendererProps<T> {
  InternalRenderer: InternalRenderer<T>;   // may equal TDefaultRenderer when no internal renderer exists
}
```

### TDefaultRenderer

```ts
type TDefaultRenderer<T extends TNode> = ComponentType<TDefaultRendererProps<T>>;
```

Fallback renderer for any `TNode`. Behavior switches on `tnode.type`.

### InternalRenderer

```ts
type InternalRenderer<T extends TNode> = ComponentType<InternalRendererProps<T>>;
```

Internal custom renderer for tags with engine-side specifics (e.g. `<img>`, `<a>`, `<ol>`, `<ul>`).

### CustomRenderer

```ts
type CustomRenderer<T extends TNode> = ComponentType<CustomRendererProps<T>>;
```

User-provided renderer (the `renderers` prop on `RenderHTML`).

### CustomBlockRenderer / CustomTextualRenderer / CustomMixedRenderer

```ts
type CustomBlockRenderer   = CustomRenderer<TBlock>;
type CustomTextualRenderer = CustomRenderer<TText | TPhrasing>;
type CustomMixedRenderer   = CustomRenderer<TBlock | TPhrasing | TText>;
```

Use the right type based on the tag's content model for TypeScript intellisense.

### InternalBlockRenderer / InternalMixedRenderer / InternalTextualRenderer

```ts
type InternalBlockRenderer   = InternalRenderer<TBlock>;
type InternalMixedRenderer   = InternalRenderer<TBlock | TPhrasing | TText>;
type InternalTextualRenderer = InternalRenderer<TPhrasing | TText>;
```

### CustomTagRendererRecord

```ts
type CustomTagRendererRecord = Record<string,
  CustomBlockRenderer | CustomTextualRenderer | CustomMixedRenderer>;
```

### InternalTextContentRenderer

```ts
type InternalTextContentRenderer = ComponentType<TNodeSubRendererProps<TText>> & {
  isNativeInternalTextRenderer: true;
};
```

Renderer for non-printable text nodes (`<wbr>`, `<br>`).

### InternalSpecialRenderedTag

```ts
type InternalSpecialRenderedTag = 'img' | 'ol' | 'ul' | 'a';
```

Tags that have internal renderers wired into `useInternalRenderer`.

### InternalRendererConfig

```ts
interface InternalRendererConfig<P> {
  Renderer: ComponentType<P>;
  rendererProps: P;
}
```

Return shape of `useInternalRenderer`.

### TChildProps

```ts
interface TChildProps {
  childElement: ReactElement;
  childTnode: TNode;
  index: number;
  key: string | number;
  propsFromParent: PropsFromParent;
}
```

### TChildrenBaseProps

```ts
interface TChildrenBaseProps {
  disableMarginCollapsing?: boolean;
  propsForChildren?: Partial<PropsFromParent>;
  renderChild?: (props: TChildProps) => ReactNode;
}
```

```ts
interface TChildrenRendererProps extends TChildrenBaseProps {

}
```

```ts
interface TNodeChildrenRendererProps extends TChildrenBaseProps {
  tnode: TNode;
```

### PropsFromParent

```ts
interface PropsFromParent extends Record<string, any> {
  collapsedMarginTop: number | null;
}
```

Props anonymous nodes pass from their parents to their children.

### RenderersProps

```ts
interface RenderersProps extends Record<string, any> {
  a: AElementConfig;
  img: ImgElementConfig;
  ol: ListElementConfig;
  ul: ListElementConfig;
}
```

Custom-renderer props by tag. Extensible via module augmentation.

### AElementConfig

```ts
interface AElementConfig {
  onPress?: (
    event: GestureResponderEvent,
    href: string,                       // normalized via useNormalizedUrl
    htmlAttribs: Record<string, string>,
    target: '_blank' | '_self' | '_parent' | '_top',
  ) => void;
}
```

### ImgElementConfig

```ts
interface ImgElementConfig {
  enableExperimentalPercentWidth?: boolean;
  initialDimensions?: ImageDimensions;  // memoize when changing
}
```

### ListElementConfig

```ts
interface ListElementConfig {
  enableDynamicMarkerBoxWidth?: boolean;            // default false
  enableExperimentalRtl?: boolean;                  // default false
  enableRemoveBottomMarginIfNested?: boolean;       // default true
  enableRemoveTopMarginIfNested?: boolean;          // default true
  getFallbackListStyleTypeFromNestLevel?: (nestLevel: number) => DefaultSupportedListStyleType;
  markerBoxStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  markerTextStyle?: TextStyle;
}
```

### RenderHTMLPassedProps

```ts
interface RenderHTMLPassedProps {
  renderersProps?: Partial<RenderersProps>;
}
```

### RenderHTMLSharedProps

Props shared across renderers; available through `useSharedProps`. Memoize them — any change invalidates the whole tree.

```ts
interface RenderHTMLSharedProps {
  GenericPressable?: ComponentType<GenericPressableProps>;
  WebView?: ComponentType<any>;
  bypassAnonymousTPhrasingNodes?: boolean;        // default true
  computeEmbeddedMaxWidth?: (contentWidth: number, tagName: string) => number;
  customListStyleSpecs?: Record<string, ListStyleSpec>;
  debug?: boolean;                                // default false
  defaultTextProps?: TextProps;
  defaultViewProps?: ViewProps;
  defaultWebViewProps?: any;
  enableExperimentalBRCollapsing?: boolean;       // default false
  enableExperimentalGhostLinesPrevention?: boolean; // default false
  enableExperimentalMarginCollapsing?: boolean;   // default false
  pressableHightlightColor?: string;              // default rgba(38,132,240,0.2)
  provideEmbeddedHeaders?: EmbeddedHeadersProvider;
}
```

### RenderHTMLAmbiantSharedProps

```ts
type RenderHTMLAmbiantSharedProps =
    Required<Pick<RenderHTMLSharedProps, SharedPropsWithoutFallback>>
  & Omit<RenderHTMLSharedProps, SharedPropsWithoutFallback>;
// SharedPropsWithoutFallback = Exclude<keyof RenderHTMLSharedProps,
//   'provideEmbeddedHeaders' | 'GenericPressable' | 'customListStyleSpecs'>;
```

Shape returned by `useSharedProps()` — defaults filled in for all keys except the three explicitly nullable fallbacks.

### RenderHTMLConfig

Props for `RenderHTMLConfigProvider`.

```ts
interface RenderHTMLConfig extends RenderHTMLSharedProps, RenderHTMLPassedProps {

  remoteLoadingView?: (source: HTMLSourceUri) => ReactElement;
  renderers?: CustomTagRendererRecord;
}
```

### HTMLSource

```ts
type HTMLSource = HTMLSourceInline | HTMLSourceDom | HTMLSourceUri;

interface HTMLSourceInline { baseUrl?: string; html: string; }

interface HTMLSourceDom    { baseUrl?: string; dom: Element | Document; } // dom must come from TRE.parseDocument

interface HTMLSourceUri {
  body?: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  method?: string;
  uri: string;
}
```

### DocumentMetadata

Available through `useDocumentMetadata()` after parsing.

```ts
interface DocumentMetadata {
  baseTarget: DocumentContext['baseTarget'];
  baseUrl: string;                   // base from <base/>, source.baseUrl, or source.uri origin
  dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl';
  lang: string;
  links: DocumentContext['links'];
  meta: DocumentContext['meta'];
  title: string;
}
```

### GenericPressableProps

```ts
interface GenericPressableProps extends AccessibilityProps {
  borderless?: boolean;
  onPress?: TouchableHighlightProps['onPress'];
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}
```

### ReactNativeProps

```ts
type ReactNativeProps =
    Pick<ViewProps, Extract<keyof ViewProps, Exclude<keyof TextProps, 'style'>>>
  & Pick<TextProps, Extract<keyof TextProps, Exclude<keyof ViewProps, 'style'>>>
  & { style?: StyleProp<Pick<ViewStyle, Extract<keyof ViewStyle, keyof TextStyle>>> };
```

Props valid on both `Text` and `View`.

### StylessReactNativeProps / StylessReactNativeTextProps / StylessReactNativeViewProps

```ts
type StylessReactNativeTextProps = Omit<TextProps, 'style'>;
type StylessReactNativeViewProps = Omit<ViewProps, 'style'> & { onPress?: () => void };
```

```ts
type DefaultSupportedListStyleType =
```
